title: iPhone 18 Pro Max — aniq hisob
caption: ❓ Savol: «iPhone 18 Pro Max'ni AQShdan posilkada olsam, qancha to'layman?» Misol: iPhone 18 Pro Max, 256 GB (Burgundy — to'q qizil) — Apple AQSh narxi 1 299 $. Kuryer orqali, shu oyda boshqa posilka yo'q. 1️⃣ Bojxona qiymati (telefon + yo'l harajati): 1 299 + 10 = 1 309 $ 2️⃣ Normadan ortig'i: 1 309 − 200 = 1 109 $ 3️⃣ Yagona bojxona to'lovi 30 %: 1 109 × 30 % = 332,70 $ (kamida 3 $/kg: 0,50 × 3 = 1,50 $ — foiz bo'yicha summa katta) → 332,70 × 11 772,95 = 3 916 860 so'm 4️⃣ 1 ta BKO uchun yig'im (BHM ning 25 %): 110 000 so'm 5️⃣ UzIMEI (30 kun ichida): 88 000 so'm 💰 To'lovlar jami: 4 114 860 so'm 📱 Hammasi (telefon + yo'l + to'lovlar): ≈ 19 526 000 so'm 📅 2027-yil 1-yanvardan stavka 20 %: 1 109 × 20 % = 221,80 $ — ≈ 1 306 000 so'm kam. ⚠️ AQSh savdo solig'i (shtatga qarab 0–10 %) hisobga olinmagan. Yakuniy summani bojxona organi belgilaydi. 📄 Asos: PQ-4508, 3-band; VM 244-son; VM 55-son, 31.01.2025; VM 778-son, 6-ilova — lex.uz 📲 Telefon bojini ilovada hisoblang ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #savol
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#savol".
2) Center: a photorealistic iPhone 18 Pro Max smartphone in a rich deep burgundy red finish (glossy-matte aluminium frame, large rectangular triple-camera plateau across the top of the back), standing upright at a slight angle, back side facing the viewer, next to an open matte cardboard parcel box; a small receipt slip with a few calculation lines and a tiny indigo tag reading IMEI beside it. Keep the phone itself photorealistic, not clay; no logo on the phone. Render the box and props as a soft 3D clay illustration (the phone stays photorealistic) with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of burgundy red (#8B1E3F); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "iPhone 18 Pro Max: qancha to'laysiz?"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Boj + yig'im + UzIMEI — aniq hisob"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.

notes: Muallif so'rovi: bojxona qiymatiga 10 $ yo'l harajati qo'shildi va 1 ta BKO yig'imi (BHM 25 % = 110 000) hisoblandi. Hisob: (1 299 + 10 − 200) × 30 % = 332,70 $ × 11772.95 = 3916860 so'm; + 110000 BKO + 88000 UzIMEI = 4114860 so'm. Telefon bilan: (1 299 + 10) × kurs + to'lovlar = 19525652 so'm. Apple narxi ($1 299) va rang (Burgundy) qidiruv natijalaridan — apple.com da tekshiring (Claude muhitidan ochilmadi). Rasm: telefon to'q qizil (Burgundy); ChatGPT'ga Apple sahifasidagi Burgundy surati biriktirilsa — aniqroq chiqadi. Og'irlik qadoq bilan ≈0,5 kg (minimal to'lov tekshiruvi uchun). UzIMEI: BHM 440 000 × 20 % = 88 000; 30 kundan keyin × 25 % = 110 000.
